comment: Fix peer_launch_adapter.validate_context() collapsing a Windows-style install-receipt path (e.g. 'N:\marketplaces\cell\...') to '.' when computing its parent directory on a POSIX host, by parsing backslash-separated receipts with PureWindowsPath instead of the host-native Path flavour. Fixes test_validate_context_treats_windows_n_drive_receipt_as_a_path, which was blocking dev->main promotion (full - agent-worktrees CI job).
